    n, m = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split(' '))
    if n % 2 == 0 and m % 2 == 0:
        if n == 2 and m == 2:
            print 0
        else:
            print n * m
        return

            print m - 3

            print n - 3

            print n * m - 1

        if n % 6 == 0 or m % 6 == 0:
            print n * m
        else:
            print n * m - 2
    elif n == 2 or m == 2:

        print n * m
